Globe.gd (LF, CODE_PATCH, compile manifest declares it): full programmatic redraw per spec 4.2 - constants FRAME=Surface 2 / INNER=Background Deep / RIM=Normal Border / RIM_FAINT a0.6 / BLOOD_DEEP #8B1F24 / BLOOD_TOP #C83E42 / SHADOW a0.30 / HILITE a0.10; _draw(): circle 80 FRAME -> 74 INNER -> arc r77 w3 RIM -> arc r70 w1 RIM_FAINT -> 32 horizontal liquid bands (chord half-width 2*sqrt(max(0,66^2-(yc-80)^2)), color BLOOD_DEEP.lerp(BLOOD_TOP, t)) when pct>0.005 -> inner-shadow arc r66 w4 SHADOW over upper rim -> highlight arc r62 w2 HILITE upper-left; _process: 120ms damage flash, modulate channel offset <=14% on orb only, restores to pure white at 0 (NO screen flash); update_progress: original two lines kept verbatim (incl. spaced $HBoxContainer / HealthLabel.text form - compile-verified), plus flash trigger when amount drops (_flash = 0.12) and update() for liquid redraw; update_progress signature unchanged -> GUI.gd zero changes. Godot 3.5 syntax: no super._draw(), draw_arc integer widths, TAU/PI globals. No new file paths (roundtrip 3744), zero gameplay impact, no baseline promotion.

entities.expected_runtime_effect: orb occupies x in [0,160], y in [640,800] (bottom-left, was [0,256]x[544,800]); no overlap with dock (x 340-940) or right-edge modules; mouse_filter=2 keeps zero hitbox

procedural orb: dark metal base + inner dark disk + outer rim ring + thin inner ring + 32-band radial-gradient liquid (Health deep -> bright) + upper inner shadow + light highlight; value slot drives liquid height
on amount decrease a 120ms sub-14%-channel modulate flash on the orb node only, auto-restoring to pure white; no screen-level red flash
